population: Exact original annual_fold rows, ordering and audit; HARP separation and observation/prediction boundary purging. Preserve zero-positive evaluation 2018; skip original non-evaluable 2019-2021 folds. No outcome-based drops.

preprocessing.fit: Training windows only, counting repeated observations as they occur in those windows; finite values only; float64 channel sums and population variance. One scaler shared by both arms and all seeds within a fold.
preprocessing.standardization: Subtract training mean and divide by population std; std below 1e-6 becomes 1. Clip scaled finite values to [-8,8]. Missing values become 0 after scaling; append bool missing masks cast to float32. Abort if any channel has no finite training values.

shuffle: For each seed and forecast key derive seed from first 8 bytes of SHA-256 of UTF-8 f"{seed}|{harp}|{forecast_time.isoformat()}" interpreted little-endian, with forecast_time normalized to UTC. numpy.default_rng permutes indices 1..58, preserving 0 and 59. Move all measurements and masks together after shared preprocessing. Fix permutation across epochs, independent of labels and batch order; apply to train, calibration and evaluation. Do not provide original timestep IDs.

training.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss with pos_weight=n_negative/n_positive from training rows; mean reduction
training.batch_order: Seeded permutation of training rows each epoch; no random split or class resampling; drop_last=False. Same batch order in paired arms.
training.stopping: Fixed 10 epochs, final checkpoint only. Abort on nonfinite tensors/loss/gradients; no early stopping or outer-score inspection.
training.determinism: Seed numpy and torch at each fit; torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True). No best-seed selection.
training.process_isolation: Launch each torch fit/inference worker using a fresh Python subprocess (exec, not fork); no sklearn/XGBoost imports in worker. Exchange predictions/checkpoints through files. Calibration and bootstrap run in parent without importing torch.

aggregation: Equal mean of the three raw sigmoid probabilities per arm; fit one SigmoidCalibration on aggregated calibration-year predictions. Separately calibrate each seed and report its transferred metrics to describe seed variation, without choosing a seed.
calibration: Existing SigmoidCalibration; select recall_threshold at >=0.95 on prior calibration year only; freeze before reading evaluation labels. No evaluation-reselected main threshold.
controls: Original frozen annual ensemble, identical evaluation keys
Frozen shared_train_one_year control from calibration-windows experiment; report separately because its training history differs; require identical evaluation keys

uncertainty.unit: Paired HARP bootstrap within each evaluation year, with fixed thresholds. Compare each aggregate against incumbent and chronological against shuffled. Intervals do not include retraining uncertainty; report seed spread separately.

success: Each comparable positive year: precision strictly higher, FP strictly lower, recall >=0.95, AP no lower, Brier/log_loss no higher than original ensemble. Require complete original coverage. For ordering hypothesis also apply same comparisons against shuffled aggregate; disclose paired confidence intervals, no significance claim from point wins alone. No automatic promotion.

budget.estimate_limit: CPU smoke extrapolation excludes loading, preprocessing, calibration, inference and bootstrap; not a runtime guarantee.

limitations: Repeatedly inspected development years are not independent final test.
Order control includes missingness chronology, not just physical magnetic evolution.
Architecture and training recipe are fixed by a bounded design, not selected for outer-year performance.
Torch-only smoke passed; mixed full-suite process crashed in native Conv1d. Root cause is unresolved; use isolated workers and fail on nonzero exit, never mask failures.
execution_clarifications: Training recipe, seeds, folds and architecture are unchanged from v1.

Development labels are read during preparation only for frozen population audits and train/calibration targets. Evaluation targets are never sent to torch workers and only enter metric calculation after thresholds are persisted.
Epoch checkpoints are interruption recovery state only; final epoch remains the sole evaluated checkpoint. Resume verifies job identity and restores optimizer plus numpy/torch RNG state.
Prepared files, sequence cache and completed jobs are hash-verified on resume. Each fit runs in a fresh exec subprocess; one runner lock prevents concurrent execution.
